cs.t: I have been using cell2jack for a year or more and have been pretty happy with it. I plugged a cordless phone with satellites stations (extra phone around the house). It connects to a cellphone via bluetooth. At first I used a flip phone but now it uses a android phone.  https://www.cell2jack.com/setup.html
